caption: The drawing consists of two rectangular frames, one above the other, each containing a colored illustration of the same brooch shown from different angles. The upper frame depicts the brooch from a top view: it is gold in color, featuring an intricate, symmetrical design with an infinity shape, ornate details, and two oval blue gemstones set at the center of each loop. The lower frame shows the brooch from a side view, emphasizing its curved form and the raised setting of the blue gemstones. The background of the drawing is a light beige, and there is a formal, serif script at the bottom reading "Westchester County" on the left and "Drawn by Wm P. Shearwood" on the right.
title: Brooch
